description: Complete Anthropic content source registry -- one of several per-provider registries (see also sources.openai.json, sources.zai.json). Discovered via robots.txt/sitemap/llms.txt probing across all known Anthropic domains, GitHub API enumeration, and package registry checks. Discovery surfaces are treated as incomplete: the fetcher also refreshes every doc already on disk, because upstream de-indexes pages it still serves. Output paths below are relative to content/anthropic/.

anthropic.com.notes: Main site: news, engineering, research, plus a fixed allowlist of standalone policy/report pages (BLOG_STANDALONE_PAGES in fetcher.py). HTML-only, no .md variant -- frozen 2026-07-08 to 2026-09 after the jina.ai proxy path was removed, unfrozen once trafilatura-based HTML scraping (server-rendered pages, no JS execution needed) replaced it. content/blog/{news,research,engineering,policy}/.

code.claude.com.notes: Claude Code + Agent SDK docs (141 en pages, 9 languages)

support.claude.com.notes: Help articles (Intercom-hosted); llms.txt with direct .md links since ~2026-07

claude.com.notes: Product docs since ~2026-08: Claude Tag, Cowork, office agents, connectors, government, claude-science, third-party. Serves .md variants under /docs/. Was recorded as cf-blocked marketing until 2026-08-24; support articles had been redirecting here for weeks. /resources/tutorials/ is HTML-only (no .md) and is not fetched.

academy.claude.com.notes: Claude Academy: 725 pages (438 courses, 149 use-cases, 120 tutorials). Found 2026-08-24 by following an off-site redirect from a dead support article. NOT FETCHED: serves no .md variant (every path 404s to an HTML shell), the same HTML-only constraint that froze the anthropic.com blog when the jina.ai proxy was dropped. Adding it needs an HTML extraction path, which is a design decision, not a fetcher config change.

alignment.anthropic.com.notes: Alignment Science blog. Distill-templated, server-rendered like anthropic.com (trafilatura works directly). No sitemap/feed/llms.txt -- every path 200s an SPA shell -- but the homepage itself lists every post across every year, so it doubles as the index. Added 2026-09-13: 60 posts, all exclusive to this domain (unlike red.anthropic.com, none redirect to www.anthropic.com).

transformer-circuits.pub.notes: Interpretability research (Transformer Circuits Thread). Same Distill template and server-rendering as alignment.anthropic.com, but discoverable via a real Atom feed at /feed.xml covering full history back to 2021. Added 2026-09-13: 56 posts, all exclusive to this domain.

red.anthropic.com.notes: Frontier Red Team blog. Checked 2026-09-13: every article except the /cvd/ dashboard page 301/308-redirects to www.anthropic.com/research/*, which research-posts already fetches. Not added as a source -- would be pure duplication of content already archived under blog/research/.

notes_on_discovery: Three signals beyond domain probing have found real gaps: (1) off-site redirects on pages we already fetch — this is how claude.com/docs (215 pages) and academy.claude.com (725 pages) surfaced, after upstream had been pointing at them for weeks; (2) refetching every doc already on disk, because sitemaps and llms.txt undercount what a site serves; (3) following outbound links on a page that was itself found by chasing a name (2026-09-13: a web search for Anthropic's 'red team blog' led to red.anthropic.com, which turned out to be pure duplication of research-posts — but a link on its index page led to alignment.anthropic.com and transformer-circuits.pub, two real domains with 116 combined posts found nowhere in sources.json). None of the three are visible to --discover, which only probes domains already listed here.
